title: Near-Optimal Single-Loop Predictor--Corrector Extragradient Method for Strongly Convex--Strongly Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We study smooth strongly convex--strongly concave minimax optimization in the deterministic unconstrained setting, without assuming a bilinear or separable structure. Although existing multi-loop methods attain near-optimal condition-number dependence, standard single-loop methods generally exhibit a substantial complexity gap. To close this gap, we propose the Single-Loop Predictor--Corrector Extragradient Method with Damped Momentum (PCE-DM), which combines an extragradient prediction--correction scheme with a novel auxiliary feedback recursion for the weaker-curvature variable.
